name: @mooter/worktree-conductor
description: Mooter Worktree Conductor (Wave 33.5 Block H) — local-first orchestration across terminals/worktrees: atomic filesystem lock manager, session heartbeats, a serial intent queue (Sequencer), and dead-session auto-recovery. Prevents cross-session races (concurrent git push / tag / hub deploy / Notion write). No daemon, no network; all state under ~/.mooter/orchestration. I/O injectable for tests.
